project_info.theme: Fresh berry juice 30 percent discount promotion
project_info.color_palette: Berry red, crimson, white, blueberry navy, citrus orange, ice clear

main_subject.detail: A centered clear glass berry-juice bottle with navy cap, wet condensation, dark label, and red berry liquid, surrounded by fruit, ice, and a red juice splash.
main_subject.style: High-energy ecommerce beverage poster with bold playful typography

composition_elements.text: FRESH JUICE; BERRY BLAST; 30% OFF; Fresh Berries; $11; Antioxidants; GRAB IT NOW!
items: Top left: oversized off-white FRESH JUICE and BERRY BLAST headline.
Upper right: circular white 30% OFF discount ring with repeated DISCOUNT text.
Center: upright chilled juice bottle with readable FRESH JUICE BERRY BLAST label.
Around bottle: strawberries, raspberries, blueberries, orange wedge, mint leaves, ice cubes, and red liquid splash.
Lower middle: white price circle reading $11.
Lower corners: handwritten white feature callouts, doodle arrows, and bold GRAB IT NOW CTA.
Background: saturated berry-red gradient with sparkling droplets, grain, and vignette.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Bright wet highlights, frozen splash, crisp typography, glittering condensation, controlled red vignette

technical_specs.resolution: Vertical high resolution, sharp text and product detail

assets.name: juice bottle and label
assets.source: attach exact bottle and packaging artwork
assets.usage: Keep bottle profile, cap, label, and beverage color unchanged.

assets.name: discount poster typography
assets.usage: Preserve all displayed headings, price, 30 percent badge, arrows, and CTA hierarchy.

prompt_instructions: Attach the bottle reference and typography layout reference.
Keep the visible wording exact, including FRESH JUICE, BERRY BLAST, 30% OFF, $11, and GRAB IT NOW!
Maintain the bottle in the vertical center with text clear of the product.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Exact uploaded [BOTTLE_NAME] bottle (label unchanged). Vertical poster. Center bottle w/ condensation. Add JUICE_COLOR liquid splash wrap + ice cubes + INGREDIENTS floating (controlled). Background: BG_COLOR gradient + vignette + grain. Top-left: “FRESH JUICE” + “[FLAVOR_TAGLINE]”. Right: circular “30% OFF” ring. Lower-right: price circle “[PRICE]”. Bottom-right CTA “[CTA]”. White doodle arrows. Studio key+rim, 85mm, sharp text, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: incorrect label, altered bottle, misspelled headline, wrong discount value, unreadable price, overcrowded fruit, dark muddy red, low resolution, watermark
